basic.name: 普通攻击：炽风斩
basic.trigger: 点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
basic.description:
点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方进行至多三段的斩击，造成物理伤害；
在每一段攻击的发动阶段，点按 【特殊技键】 将触发[烬风]，使此次攻击造成更高火属性伤害。
basic.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] to activate:
Perform up to three forward slashes, dealing Physical DMG.
During each slash, pressing [Special Attack] triggers Scorchwind, causing the attack to deal increased Fire DMG.

special.name: 特殊技：归烬
special.trigger: 点按 【特殊技键】 发动：
special.description:
点按 【特殊技键】 发动：
向前方斩击敌人，造成火属性伤害；
如果招式发动期间受到敌人攻击，在发动斩击时回复20%已损失生命值，[特殊技：归烬]和[特殊技：归烬·舍身]的生命回复效果每20秒最多触发一次；
如果招式发动期间受到敌人攻击，强化此次斩击；
招式发动期间受到伤害降低40%；
招式发动期间抗打断等级提升。
special.descriptionEn:
Press [Special Attack] to activate:
Slash forward at enemies, dealing Fire DMG.
If hit by an enemy during the skill, restore 20% of missing HP when unleashing the slash. The healing effects of Special Attack: Return to Ashes and Special Attack: Return to Ashes - Sacrifice have a shared cooldown and can trigger once every 20s.
If hit by an enemy during the skill, the slash is enhanced.
DMG taken is reduced by 40% while using this skill.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

ex.name: 强化特殊技：归烬·天坠
ex.nameEn: EX Special Attack: Return to Ashes - Fall
ex.trigger: 在[熔锋]状态下，闪能足够时，点按  【强化特殊技键】 发动：
ex.triggerEn: While in the Molten Edge state and with sufficient Adrenaline, press [EX Special Attack] to activate:
ex.description:
在[熔锋]状态下，闪能足够时，点按  【强化特殊技键】 发动：
跳起并发动向前方敌人发动下落斩击，造成大量火属性伤害；
招式发动时，回复33%最大生命值；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
ex.descriptionEn:
While in the Molten Edge state and with sufficient Adrenaline, press [EX Special Attack] to activate:
Jump up and unleash a falling slash on enemies in front, dealing massive Fire DMG.
Upon activating the skill, restore 33% of Max HP.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

dodgeCounter.name: 闪避反击：曜刃·掠阵
dodgeCounter.nameEn: Dodge Counter: Radiant Blade - Battle Sweep
dodgeCounter.trigger: 触发[极限闪避]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
dodgeCounter.triggerEn: Press [Basic Attack] during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
dodgeCounter.description:
触发[极限闪避]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
对前方敌人发动斩击和拳击，造成火属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
dodgeCounter.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
Perform a slash followed by a punch at enemies ahead, dealing Fire DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

chain.name: 连携技：极炽炎爆
chain.trigger: 触发[连携技]时，选择对应角色发动：
chain.triggerEn: When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
chain.description:
触发[连携技]时，选择对应角色发动：
丢出手中的剑，随后冲向敌人引发爆炸，造成大量火属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
chain.descriptionEn:
When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
Hurls his sword forward, then charges the enemy to trigger an explosion, dealing massive Fire DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

ultimate.name: 终结技：无想荒魂
ultimate.trigger: 喧响等级达到[极]时，点按 【终结技键】 发动：
ultimate.triggerEn: When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [Ultimate] to activate:
ultimate.description:
喧响等级达到[极]时，点按 【终结技键】 发动：
跳起并发动向前方敌人发动下落斩击，随后引发爆炸，造成大量火属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
ultimate.descriptionEn:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [Ultimate] to activate:
Jump into the air and deliver a falling slash at enemies in front, followed by an explosion, dealing massive Fire DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

quickAssist.name: 快速支援：孤影·归阵
quickAssist.trigger: 当前操作中的角色被击飞时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
quickAssist.triggerEn: When the active character is launched, press [Switch] to activate:
quickAssist.description:
当前操作中的角色被击飞时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
对前方敌人发动斩击和拳击，造成火属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
quickAssist.descriptionEn:
When the active character is launched, press [Switch] to activate:
Slashes and punches enemies in front, dealing Fire DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

defensiveAssist.name: 招架支援：孤影·岳峙
defensiveAssist.nameEn: Defensive Assist: Lone Shadow - Mountain Stand
defensiveAssist.trigger: 前场角色即将被攻击时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
defensiveAssist.triggerEn: When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press [Switch] to activate:
defensiveAssist.description:
前场角色即将被攻击时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
招架敌人的攻击，累积大量失衡值，并造成火属性伤害；
招式发动时，回复75点[炽心]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
defensiveAssist.descriptionEn:
When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press [Switch] to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, inflicting massive Daze and dealing Fire DMG.
Gain 75 Blazing Heart upon activating this skill.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

assistFollowup.name: 支援突击：孤影·断獠
assistFollowup.nameEn: Assist Follow-Up: Lone Shadow - Breaking Fang
assistFollowup.trigger: 发动[招架支援]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
assistFollowup.triggerEn: Press [Basic Attack] after a Defensive Assist to activate:
assistFollowup.description:
发动[招架支援]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
对前方敌人发动多段斩击，造成火属性伤害；
连点时，可以连续斩击敌人，最多额外连续斩击7次；
连续斩击时，如果真斗的生命值在30%以上，则消耗2%最大生命值；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
assistFollowup.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] after a Defensive Assist to activate:
Unleash multiple slashes at enemies ahead, dealing Fire DMG.
Repeated presses allow up to 7 extra consecutive slashes.
While chaining slashes, if Manato's HP is above 30%, 2% of Max HP is consumed.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

facts.text:
真斗会额外根据自身最大生命值提高贯穿力，每1点最大生命值将提高0.1点贯穿力；
真斗发动招式造成的火属性伤害均为贯穿伤害，无视敌人防御，使用贯穿力作为招式伤害倍率；
真斗发动[特殊技：归烬·舍身]或[招架支援]时，会累积[炽心]，最多累积100点；当[炽心]累积至75点时，真斗将进入[熔锋]状态，[熔锋]状态下，真斗每秒消耗3.3点[炽心]，[炽心]耗尽时，退出[熔锋]状态；
[熔锋]状态下，真斗的[普通攻击]获得强化，并可以发动[强化特殊技：归烬·天坠]；
真斗在[普通攻击：炽风·胧切]或[支援突击]的连续斩击中消耗生命值时，使此次攻击的暴击伤害提升50%，闪能回复效率提升100%；
[熔锋]状态下，真斗的暴击率提升10%，火属性伤害提升20%。
facts.textEn:
Manato gains extra Sheer Force based on his Max HP, with every 1 point of Max HP increasing Sheer Force by 0.1.
All Fire DMG Manato deals is Sheer DMG, ignoring enemy DEF and using his Sheer Force stat as the DMG Multiplier.
When Manato uses Special Attack: Return to Ashes - Sacrifice or a Defensive Assist, he accumulates Blazing Heart, up to a maximum of 100 points. At 75 Blazing Heart, Manato enters the Molten Edge state. While in the Molten Edge state, Manato consumes 3.3 Blazing Heart per second. When Blazing Heart is fully depleted, he exits Molten Edge.
While in the Molten Edge state, Manato's Basic Attacks are enhanced, and he can use EX Special Attack: Return to Ashes - Fall.
When consuming HP during Basic Attack: Blazing Wind - Misty Slash or during the consecutive slashes from an Assist Follow-Up, that attack's CRIT DMG increases by 50%, and the Adrenaline Generation Rate increases by 100%.
While in the Molten Edge state, Manato's CRIT Rate increases by 10%, and his Fire DMG increases by 20%.

cinema.name: 流浪生存法则
cinema.description: 真斗的生命值降低时，累积已损失生命值，每有相当于最大生命值1%的已损失生命值使[支援突击]和[普通攻击]造成的火属性伤害提升0.4%，最多提升20%。
cinema.descriptionEn: Whenever Manato loses HP, the amount of HP lost is tallied. Each 1% of his Max HP tallied increases the Fire DMG of Assist Follow-Ups and Basic Attacks by 0.4%, up to a max of 20%.

cinema.name: 昼夜、厨房与爱
cinema.description: [熔锋]状态下，真斗无视目标8%火属性伤害抗性；[特殊技：归烬]或[特殊技：归烬·舍身]发动期间受到敌人攻击后，点按 【普通攻击键】 可以发动[支援突击]。
cinema.descriptionEn: While in the Molten Edge state, Manato ignores 8% of a target's Fire RES. After being hit by an enemy while using Special Attack: Return to Ashes or Special Attack: Return to Ashes - Sacrifice, press [Basic Attack] to trigger an Assist Follow-Up.

cinema.name: 踏入怪谈世界
cinema.nameEn: Enter the Realm of Urban Legends
cinema.description: [普通攻击]、[闪避]、[支援技]、[特殊技]、[连携技] 技能等级+2
cinema.descriptionEn: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2

cinema.name: 幼年的誓言
cinema.description: 最大生命值提升8%；[特殊技：归烬]和[特殊技：归烬·舍身]发动期间，真斗受到致命伤害时不会在招式发动期间战败退场，生命值最多降低至1，10秒内最多触发一次。
cinema.descriptionEn: Max HP increases by 8%. During Special Attack: Return to Ashes and Special Attack: Return to Ashes - Sacrifice, when Manato takes fatal DMG, he remains in battle, with his HP not dropping below 1. This effect can trigger once every 10s.

cinema.name: 孤影归群
cinema.nameEn: Lone Shadow Returns to the Pack
cinema.description: [普通攻击]、[闪避]、[支援技]、[特殊技]、[连携技] 技能等级+2
cinema.descriptionEn: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2

cinema.name: 越过昔年梦
cinema.description: [特殊技：归烬]命中处于失衡状态下的敌人时，真斗回复75点[炽心]，获得4层[残焰]，点按 【普通攻击键】 可以发动[支援突击]，获得[残焰]的效果在20秒内最多触发一次；[支援突击]命中敌人时，造成的火属性伤害提升3%，持续8秒，最多叠加5层，重复触发刷新持续时间。
cinema.descriptionEn: When Special Attack: Return to Ashes hits a Stunned enemy, Manato gains 75 Blazing Heart and 4 stacks of Remnant Flame, and pressing [Basic Attack] will launch an Assist Follow-Up. This Remnant Flame effect can trigger once every 20s. When his Assist Follow-Up hits an enemy, Manato's Fire DMG increases by 3% for 8s, stacking up to 5 times. Repeated triggers reset the duration.

ultimate.descriptionEn:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [Ultimate] to activate:
Jump into the air and deliver a falling slash at enemies in front, followed by an explosion, dealing massive Fire DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

quickAssist.name: 快速支援：孤影·归阵
quickAssist.description:
当前操作中的角色被击飞时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
对前方敌人发动斩击和拳击，造成火属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
quickAssist.descriptionEn:
When the active character is launched, press [Switch] to activate:
Slashes and punches enemies in front, dealing Fire DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
